scenicChapters.title: Rogue Umpqua Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 59 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

rogue-umpqua-scenic-byway-roseburg-crate.story: 293 km from Roseburg to the finish, about 4 h 05 of riding. It goes by way of Toketee Falls and Diamond Lake. The highest point is about 1,700 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
